en: mineral gender, learning about being aware, 1st density life form
desire gender, 2nd density life form, learning to fulfill desires, akin to plant, animals, electronics
vegetal gender, 2nd density life form, learning to fulfill desires, akin to plant, fungi, basic electronics
zoic gender, 2nd density life form, learning to fullfill desires, akin to animals, basic computers, basic robots
rational gender, any entity capable of reason, 3rd density life form or higher

choice gender, 3rd density life form, learning to make choices, choosing whether to be service to self, service to others, or to remain lost, akin to basic homo sapiens, cetaceans (dolphins/whales), advanced animals
love gender, 4th density life form, learning to forgive and love all, akin to Jesus when he was on Earth, Bodhisattva, Hatonn, Gray aliens
wise gender, 5th density life form, learning wisdom, akin to Jesus Ascended, Latwii, Arcturians, shape shifting aliens
research gender, 6th density life form, learning to blend love and wisdom, akin to Ra, Gandhi, Tesla, Prophet Mohammad (pbuh)
vehicle gender, 7th density life form, learning about timelines, akin to spirit of a ship/vehicle/spaceship
locality gender, 8th density life form, learning to be oversoul, akin to spirit of a place or flock
planetary gender, 9th density life form, akin to spirit of a planet, Gaia, Venus, Luna
star gender, 10th density life form, akin to spirit of a star, Sol, Sirius
galaxy gender, 11th density life form, akin to spirit of cosmos, Milky Way, Andromeda
universe gender, 12th density life form, akin to spirit of cosmos, Sophia
abstract gender, for making new genders, for example tlansr6h would be the gender of the one infinite creator God.
hesternal tense, past day tense, for things that happened yesterday.
perfective aspect, a completed action taken as a whole.
imperfective aspect, an incomplete action in process.
frequentative aspect, something that happens frequently.
potential mood, something that is probable according to the speaker.
jussive mood, for remote commands that are to be conveyed to another recipient.
dubitative mood, for saying things the speaker is doubtful of, as for expressing sarcasm.
benedictive mood, for expressing blessings.
declarative mood, for declaring the begining of a program or essay.
realis mood, for declaring something, the most common kind of sentence.
epistemic mood, to indicate that something is possible.
deontic mood, to indicate what should be different.
imperative mood, to indicate direct commands.
desiderative mood, to indicate what the speaker wants to happen.
imprecative mood, for uttering curses.
hortative mood, for pleading or begging.
interrogative mood, for questions.
precative mood, for requests.
conditional mood, for if then statements. The if clause comes before the `cu' the then clause comes after.
habitual aspect, something that happens habitualy.
